perItemFindings.label: ass:treatment-consistency
perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.PO.POSystem.Consistency` is universal factual-plus-composition consistency for every regime and variable, not the core atom `D = D_Z`; defining this atom as `P.Consistency` silently strengthens it.

perItemFindings.label: ass:iid-sampling
perItemFindings.one_line: `IIDSample` stores its own sequence `Z : ℕ → Ω → 𝒪`; `Nonempty (IIDSample Ω 𝒪 μ Pobs)` only asserts some IID sequence exists and does not state that its `Z` is the declared sample `O`.

perItemFindings.label: prop:capacity-identification
perItemFindings.one_line: `POSystem.eventCondExp_of_consistency_IndepCF` requires `P.IndepCF`, whereas the plan supplies only `CondIndepCF` given `X`; `CondIndepCF.project` remains conditional and cannot discharge that argument.

review.verbatim_critique: Re-plan `ass:treatment-consistency` as the narrow local D-under-Z condition rather than reuse of global `POSystem.Consistency`; pin `ass:iid-sampling` to the specified sample sequence (for example by an IID witness whose `Z = O`); and replace the capacity-identification use of the unconditional `eventCondExp_of_consistency_IndepCF` with the conditional bundle route (`POCFBundle.condExpRatio_of_consistency_CondIndepCFBundle`) or a stated local bridge. The inspected reused source files contain no sorry debt.

reason: Case 7 / per-boundary heuristic (reuse-fit + abstraction-level flags) with regression pattern (b): the first two rejects were purely mechanical (plan.json schema `source`/`citations` fields, then a P4 kind-vs-hyps violation) and consumed two of three attempts on non-substantive edits, so the only substantive verdict — attempt 3's reuse-fit flags — has never been given a producer round. The defect is entirely in plan.json's node→Causalean mapping, not in the .tex math and not in any Lean encoding (no scaffold exists yet at 1.5). Verified against the substrate: `IIDSample` does carry its own sequence field `S.Z` (Causalean/Stat/Concentration/TailBounds/EmpiricalBernstein.lean:85, Causalean/Stat/Quantile/EmpiricalQuantile.lean:58), so `Nonempty (IIDSample …)` genuinely fails to pin the declared sample `O`; and the reviewer's suggested replacement `POCFBundle.condExpRatio_of_consistency_CondIndepCFBundle` exists (Causalean/PO/Conditioning/EventCondExpBundle.lean:170) and is the conditional-bundle counterpart of the unconditional `eventCondExp_of_consistency_IndepCF` the plan wrongly cited. All three fixes are bounded re-plans of named nodes, so stage_1 is the closest sufficient rewind; no hypothesis is being added, removed, or weakened relative to the .tex, so this is not Bucket A and does not warrant stage_0.
proposed_action: Re-plan exactly the three flagged nodes in plan.json, leaving every other node's disposition/member/module/env decision untouched and keeping one-to-one core coverage: (1) `ass:treatment-consistency` — drop reuse of `Causalean.PO.POSystem.Consistency` (universal factual-plus-composition consistency over all regimes/variables) and state the narrow local atom as a theorem-local hypothesis `D = D_Z` (observed treatment equals the potential treatment at the realized instrument), recorded as a local `def`/hyp with a `bypass-justified` line noting the abstraction mismatch; (2) `ass:iid-sampling` — replace `Nonempty (IIDSample Ω 𝒪 μ Pobs)` with a pinned witness `(S : IIDSample Ω 𝒪 μ Pobs) (hS : S.Z = O)` (or equivalent `∀ i, S.Z i = O i`) so the IID structure is tied to the declared sample sequence `O` rather than to some unrelated existential sequence; (3) `prop:capacity-identification` — replace the reuse of `POSystem.eventCondExp_of_consistency_IndepCF` (which demands unconditional `P.IndepCF`) with `POCFBundle.condExpRatio_of_consistency_CondIndepCFBundle` at Causalean/PO/Conditioning/EventCondExpBundle.lean:170, threading the plan's `CondIndepCF` given `X` into the bundle's conditional hypothesis; if the bundle's signature does not match, plan an explicit local bridge lemma node instead of invoking `CondIndepCF.project`. Also carry forward the already-applied schema fixes (string `source` on the three cited gate nodes, full title/authors/year/url on all `citations[]`) and keep `lem:finite-multinomial-central-limit` free of plan-level `hyps` under `lean_kind: assumption`.

perItemFindings.label: def:plugin-endpoint-estimator
perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.Stat.IIDSample.empiricalMeasure` is specialized to `IIDSample Ω ℝ μ P` and returns `Measure ℝ`; it cannot supply the empirical law/frequencies for the finite observed type `𝒪` used here.

perItemFindings.label: thm:uniform-deterministic-guard
perItemFindings.one_line: `Stat.integral_empiricalMass` and `_sq` are product-space lemmas over `Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => P)`, not moment lemmas for an arbitrary `IIDSample Ω 𝒪 μ P`; they cannot be applied directly to the pinned sample `S.Z`.

review.verbatim_critique: Drop the claimed generic use of `IIDSample.empiricalMeasure`; define the finite empirical frequencies from `O`/`S.Z` via `empiricalMass` or finite sums. Replan the guard's Chebyshev step around the actual IID-sample theorem `Causalean.Stat.IIDSample.sampleMean_sub_sq_lintegral_le` in `Causalean.Stat.EmpiricalProcess.CrossFitRate` (applied to singleton indicators), or explicitly plan the nontrivial pushforward-to-product bridge before using the product-space `integral_empiricalMass` lemmas.

perItemFindings.label: S1 / ass:iv-independence
perItemFindings.one_line: `POSystem` is the right carrier, but the planned `POSlateSystem` only lists five `POVar`s: it must require their distinct underlying nodes and explicitly carry/quantify `[StandardBorelSpace P.Ω]`, required for the reused `POSystem.CondIndepCF`; neither follows from finite `X` or from constructed witnesses.

review.verbatim_critique: Keep the POSystem reuse, but re-plan S1/POSlateSystem with pairwise-distinct X,Z,D,S,Y node indices and an explicit StandardBorel ambient-world requirement wherever IVIndependence/conditional-bundle identification is defined. This prevents malformed node aliasing and an undeclared typeclass prerequisite in the reused conditional-independence predicate.

perItemFindings.label: S3 / ass:iid-sampling
perItemFindings.one_line: `Causalean.Stat.IIDSample` is an ℕ-indexed `iIndepFun` sequence on one sampling space, but the plan claims a finite-n model needing no infinite extension while binding `S : IIDSample` and using its all-index CLT/moment results; this is an unrecorded stronger sampling world.

review.verbatim_critique: Re-plan S3 and `ass:iid-sampling` consistently: either explicitly model the core sample as an infinite i.i.d. sequence (and remove the contrary finite-n/no-extension claim), or retain a genuinely finite-n local sampling structure and provide a sound bridge to every reused asymptotic result. The current wrapper only pins an already-infinite `IIDSample` to `O`, so it does not realize the stated finite-n sampling model.
